periods.analysis: Terminal 5 Modernization & Checkpoint Expansion opened the reporting arc at 12% complete and green, which is the right posture for a gateway asset serving Harborview’s fast-growing airport and seaport economy. Concourse design + FAA sign-off is complete with the milestone shown 180 days past due offset, and that early regulatory closure gives the field team a clean lane for phased construction. The two additional CBP/TSA lanes are in-progress with a 30-day due offset, while concessions build-out remains not-started with a 150-day due offset. Dana Okonkwo’s team has set up the work in Pier B, Gate T5-14, and the north checkpoint back-of-house corridor so passenger flow is protected before the heavier lift begins.
periods.recommendations: Sustain the green status by keeping the weekly FAA, TSA, CBP, and Harborview Aviation coordination huddle locked through the next procurement gate. Extend early enabling work by pre-staging conduit, queuing stanchions, and temporary wayfinding in the north checkpoint before lane equipment arrives. Hold concessions at design-readiness only until the checkpoint lane procurement clears its next 30-day decision point.
